pages.text: The $(l)Garden Gnome$() is a peaceful and highly efficient land helper. He moves $(b)faster$() than the Hay Farmer, ensuring your crops are handled with superior agility.

pages.title: Farming Operations
pages.text: $(b)Equip him with shears$() to start. He will:$(li)$(6)Harvest$() grown crops.$(li)$(6)Replant$() seeds.$(li)$(6)Store$() items in chest.

pages.title: Chest Assignment
pages.text: Use the $(b)Toy Command Staff$() to assign a storage chest:$(li)$(6)Shift + Right Click$() on the chest to set its position.$(li)$(6)Shift + Right Click$() again to confirm the assignment.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 0$(br2)$(c)Notice:$() Known for his $(b)quick movement$() on the field. He remains $(b)strictly peaceful$() and cannot fight. Keep him protected!
Crafted with organic materials and the enduring hardness of a realistic garden.
